title: Frisco Lands New Taylor Sheridan Series Starring Samuel L. Jackson - NewsBreak
text:
By Matilda Preisendorf ,
3 hours ago The "Sheridan-verse" is officially moving into Frisco‚Äôs backyard. After months of rumors and a major creative pivot, Paramount+ announced Tuesday (via Variety ) that the highly anticipated Tulsa King spinoff has ditched its New Orleans roots for North Texas. Rebranded as Frisco King , the series will trade the French Quarter for the fast-growing suburbs of Frisco, bringing Hollywood heavyweight Samuel L. Jackson along for the ride. From "NOLA" To North Texas The project, originally developed under the title NOLA King , was initially slated to immerse viewers in the gritty underworld of New Orleans. However, a significant shakeup behind the scenes led to a total reimagining of the series. In a move that will thrill local fans of the Taylor Sheridan empire, the show‚Äôs setting has been officially relocated. While insiders suggest the plot may still make brief cameos in Louisiana, the heart of the narrative will now beat in Frisco, Texas. Taylor Sheridan Takes the Reins The shift to Frisco isn't just a change in scenery; it represents a deeper involvement from the architect of the Yellowstone universe himself.
